depictions.note: Wall of screens with faces representing deepfake videos, visually demonstrating volume.
Continuation of the wall of screens, showing the growth in deepfake videos by lighting up more screens.
Conveyor belt machine demonstrating deepfake detection rates by passing or failing screens with faces.
Money vault demonstrating financial loss due to AI fraud, with money spilling out to show scale.

grades.one_line: This video effectively demonstrates the alarming growth and impact of deepfake fraud with engaging visuals and a well-integrated mascot.
problems: The initial deepfake video count demonstration (seg0/seg1) is visually effective but less dynamic compared to the interactive detection and financial loss segments.
fixes: Consider adding more dynamic elements or a stronger visual progression within the deepfake video count scene to match the energy of later segments.
